_note: Benchmark for scripts/eval_study_index.py: talk-prep-style questions, worded so they don't simply repeat the verse's own words (that would only test keyword search), each paired with well-known passages a good result list should include. A hit counts if a scripture or cross-reference piece covers any listed verse. Not exhaustive - other good answers exist for most questions, so treat scores as relative (before vs. after a change), not absolute.
